$comment: Chain reference data 00_Preflight.s.sol probes on chain. This is the deployment-side mirror of packages/config/src/index.ts (addresses.4663) — the Foundry root cannot read outside contracts/, so the two files carry the same addresses and must be changed together. NOTHING HERE IS VERIFIED: Phase 0 of the plan re-reads every one of these on chain, and 00_Preflight is the script that does it. An entry whose address is zero is a Phase 0 placeholder and is reported as TODO rather than probed.
poolManagerCodeHashNote: keccak256 of the deployed PoolManager runtime code, pinned against Uniswap v4-core 1.0.2. TODO: Phase 0 records `cast keccak $(cast code $POOL_MANAGER)` here; while it is zero the check reports TODO instead of comparing.

infrastructure.name: poolManager
infrastructure.note: Uniswap v4 PoolManager. Every Amplestocks pool lives here.

infrastructure.name: positionManager
infrastructure.note: v4 PositionManager. Not used by the protocol; the dApp and third-party LPs read it.

infrastructure.name: stateView
infrastructure.note: v4 StateView. The indexer and the keeper read pool state through it.

infrastructure.name: v4Quoter
infrastructure.note: v4 Quoter. The quote-never-reverts exit criterion is measured against it.

infrastructure.name: universalRouter
infrastructure.note: The live UniversalRouter. The two-hop rotation route is one V4_SWAP command through it.

infrastructure.name: permit2
infrastructure.note: Canonical Permit2, the UniversalRouter's token approval path.

infrastructure.name: weth9
infrastructure.note: The AMPS/WETH entry pool's counter asset. Native ETH is address(0) and would take currency0 from AMPS, so the route wraps.

infrastructure.name: usdg
infrastructure.note: USDG, 6 decimals, the hub pool's counter asset and the BountyPot's unit.

infrastructure.name: usdc
infrastructure.note: Bridged USDC. Only the dApp's Across zap touches it.

infrastructure.name: create2Factory
infrastructure.note: Canonical deterministic-deployment proxy. Recorded UNVERIFIED on 4663: this check is what verifies it. Amps, the four vault libraries and AmpsHook are all mined against it.

infrastructure.name: multicall3
infrastructure.note: Canonical Multicall3. The dApp and the indexer batch reads through it.

infrastructure.name: safeL2Singleton
infrastructure.note: Safe v1.4.1 L2 singleton. The proposer Safe 3/5 and the guardian Safe 2/4 are deployed from it.

infrastructure.name: chainlinkStreamsVerifierProxy
infrastructure.note: Data Streams VerifierProxy. v1 does not use it; StreamsRelay in v1.5 will.

infrastructure.name: acrossSpokePool
infrastructure.note: Across SpokePool. The dApp's USDC -> USDG zap.

infrastructure.name: stockTokenBeacon
infrastructure.note: The Stock Token beacon. blockAccounts(0x6abf7081) on it is the indexer's denylist alarm.

precompiles.note: Arbitrum Orbit precompiles. arbOSVersion() gives the ArbOS version (61 expected, i.e. EIP-7702 live and EIP-1153 available); getGasAccountingParams() returns (speedLimitPerSecond, gasPoolMax, maxTxGasLimit), the last of which bounds a single deployment or a 32-pool checkpoint().
